item.name: Newspaper
item.info: The Newspaper industry might be dying, but you certianly found a good use for this one.

item.name: Broom
item.info: Zora Neale Hurston told me to grab the broom of anger and drive off the beast of fear, now I get it!

item.name: Golf Club
item.info: They say there's nothing more satisfying than getting a hole in one, I beg to differ.

item.name: Mop
item.info: Time to for this seasoned mop to clean up a new type of mess, when a pigeon is hit by the mop they become wet, slowing them down.

item.name: Rake
item.info: Leaves... Pigeons... What's the difference? They both attack from above and are hard to clean up after.

item.name: Baseball Bat
item.info: Baseball just got a lot more interesting, knock those Pigeons out of the park with this hard hitter.

item.name: Pool Stick
item.info: Pigeon ball, sky pocket. Pool is 90% mental, 10% physical and now; it's 100% personal.

item.name: Numchucks
item.info: Time to go ninja on these pigeons. The Numchucks enable double jump, effectively transforming you into a high flying pigeon eliminating machine.

item.name: Shovel
item.info: Any pigeon that gets in the way of this grave digger is sure to be K.O.ed; but the shovel is heavy so it will slow you down.

item.name: Rock
item.info: The Rock is your ol' reliable. With good aim it never fails to get rid of pigeons.

item.name: Hand Full Of Rocks
item.info: Throw a Hand FULL of Rocks, good for taking out a cluster of low flying pigeons.

item.name: Tennis Ball
item.info: The Tennis Ball is very bouncy, when it hits a pigeon it always bounces up.

item.name: Water Balloon
item.info: The Water Balloon explodes on contact getting all nearby pigeons wet. Wet pigeons fly much slower and can't land until they dry off.

item.name: Yo-Yo
item.info: They said all those years of practice with the Yo-Yo as a child would never pay off... Well you'll show them!

item.name: Vinyl Record
item.info: The Vinyl Record has a very wild flight pattern and shatters when it hits anything, but you can throw so many so fast that it doesn't even really matter.

item.name: Firecracker
item.info: The Firecracker explodes on contact, the explosion can take out multiple pigeons at once.

item.name: Baseball
item.info: The Baseball barely bounces when it hits a pigeon and will go through multiple pigeons without losing any momentum.

item.name: Boomerang
item.info: That's not a projectile, THIS is a projectile! The Boomerang always comes back to you and will K.O. many of the pigeons in its path.
